text:
Maya Lin: Big news — I got promoted to Senior PM today!!! still shocked. thank you all for the support 389
Oliver Grant: WHAAAAT!! huge congrats Maya!! finally they recognized your spreadsheet sorcery :trophy: 
Dani Ruiz: omg congrats!!! team lunch? coffee? confetti?
Maya Lin: cake planned at 4pm in kitchen. also small request: i'm 14 weeks along so we were waiting to share... baby on the way 476337 feeling emotional
Priya Shah: DOUBLE CONGRATS!!!! this is the best news. when's the due date? do you want us to plan a tiny shower at the office?
Maya Lin: due late October. a tiny office shower would be so lovely, not huge, just cupcakes + cards.
Oliver Grant: cupcakes + a donut poll. priority: maple bacon or classic glazed?
Dani Ruiz: maple bacon is peak.
Priya Shah: classic glazed for the purists.
HR-bot: Friendly reminder: parental leave policy posted in #people-ops. Congrats Maya!
calendar-bot: Event created: "Maya - Promotion + Baby Mini Celebration" Today 4:00 PM - 30 minutes.
Maya Lin: also hey, thank you for the mentorship and pairing on the roadmap these last 6 months. couldn't have done it without you all.
Oliver Grant: proud of you. also i will cry at the cupcakes.
Dani Ruiz: volunteering to be in charge of cards and a terrible pun-based banner.
Priya Shah: i can run the signup sheet — gluten-free option included.
Maya Lin: FYI if anyone wants to donate a onesie, size 3-6 months. no pressure at all.
Oliver Grant: i'll bring a tiny dinosaur onesie because of course i will.
HR-bot: Note: If you'd like to contribute to a group gift, please check the #people-ops channel for guidelines.
Dani Ruiz: quick poll: does Maya get a temporary throne (aka office chair upgrade) for the week? :crown:
Priya Shah: yes. mandatory.
Maya Lin: throne accepted but only if olive branch of continuing to do sprint retros with me 60a
Oliver Grant: deal. congrats again Maya!! bringing confetti cannons (safe office version).
